concept.zh: 读写字典并累计同类物品
concept.en: Read, update, and tally by key

brief.zh: 写好 inventory_counts(values)。接收一列零件名称，返回每个名称和数量配对的字典。
brief.en: Complete inventory_counts(values). Take a list of part names and return a dictionary pairing each name with its count.

hints.zh: 起始代码已经为每个零件进入一次循环。已有名称就更新数量，新名称就记 1。
hints.en: The starter already loops once for each part. Update the count for a known name or store 1 for a new name.

hints.zh: 把光标点到代码末尾，添加判断和返回字典两个片段。最后一条 return 会在循环做完以后运行。
hints.en: Click at the end of the code and insert the decision and return snippets. The final return runs after the loop has finished.

label.zh: 判断这个名称是否已经计过
label.en: Check whether this part has already been counted
